# Copilot instructions

## Repository overview

- This repository contains personal data-structures-and-algorithms practice and short system-design notes.
- Algorithm exercises are standalone Python files, generally written in LeetCode format.

## Python conventions

- Preserve the LeetCode-style `class Solution` and expected method names when extending an exercise.
- Use clear type hints such as `List[int]` and `-> bool` when the surrounding file uses them.
- Prefer straightforward, readable algorithms with the expected time and space complexity documented when useful.
- Keep explanatory comments focused on the problem statement, algorithm, or Python concepts being practiced.
- Match the existing indentation and naming style in the file being edited; do not reformat unrelated exercises.

## Validation

- For algorithm changes, run the file with a small set of representative inputs or use a focused Python check.
- Do not add dependencies, test frameworks, or project-wide tooling unless explicitly requested.
- Keep system-design notes in Markdown and preserve their educational, concise style.
